svg.title: AdS₅ × S⁵ / N = 4 SYM: a circular Wilson loop on the conformal boundary and its minimal string worldsheet in Euclidean AdS₅
svg.desc: A coordinate schematic of the circular Wilson-loop solution r²+z²=R². The closed contour C lies at z=0 and bounds a hemispherical string worldsheet Σ. The surface is minimal with respect to the AdS metric, not the flat metric of this drawing. Solid and dashed mesh lines distinguish visible and hidden portions. The surface sits inside AdS; it is not a picture of the entire bulk. Increasing radial coordinate z corresponds to lower boundary energy scales. This is a canonical large-N, strong-coupling N=4 super Yang–Mills example, separate from the finite SU(2) quantum-link model.
